items.context: @CaffeSatoshi (10.810 seguidores, cuenta mediana), en inglés: defiende que la power law original de Dacoinminster (feb-2013) nunca se reajustó; con BTC cerca de $59.000 la línea marca ~$100.800 (~0,59×). ~13 min, 0 respuestas, 136 vistas. Power law: calza exacto con el gráfico propio de la curva de 2013 (techo 2017 a 9,4×, mínimo 2018 bajo la curva).
items.suggested_text:
Worth adding the other side of that same line, because it shows how wide the orbit really is. Against the untouched 2013 formula, the 2017 top printed about 9.4× the curve, and the 2018 low went below it. So ~0.59× isn't an anomaly for this model; it sits inside a range that has always swung hard in both directions.

That's also the honest strength of a fit nobody re-touched: it can't be accused of hindsight, and it never claimed to be a floor, only a trend that counts days. I charted the original 2013 curve against the full daily $BTC history, extended to 2060: https://x.com/ForecastQuant/status/2122317683030941979

The more interesting question may not be whether price returns to the line, but whether the swings around it are quietly narrowing as the asset matures.
